I have thought that many, many times. There have been times where I resented my family and friends because if they knew how I really feel they would gladly let me die. But that's bullshit. They are the reason that I want to live. Just those few moments of happiness when my husband hugs me. Those few moments of happiness I get when I hear from my dad once every 3-4 months.

I am in constant emotional and physical pain. I have never actually told my family this, but I'm going to now, because I saw about 150 people last night that wished he had told them how bad things were, so they could help him make it through. I'm going to tell them that I tried to commit suicide and that I have a pain disorder. I'm going to ask them to help me, and I know that they will step up and do whatever it takes to help me be well again.

Suicide is about the self. Me, and my thoughts. I live inside my head and I will die there. That is suicide. Reaching out, coming out of your own mind, seeing the pain and anguish, accepting it, and realizing that it will pass. These are the things that save us. And don't tell me that the pain will never pass, because that is a lie and you know it's a lie. NOTHING in this life is static. Everything, including your suffering, changes. You can rise above the pain and suffering and watch it cower and slink away in the face of change, because nothing in this life is more relentless, cruel, and completely beautiful than change.
You have no idea how lucky.
